spec_match.rationale: zipKeyed over an object of iterables yielding records — the exact keyed form, run natively on this build, with mode handling for ragged columns.

interactive.rationale: Column textarea and mode select rebuild the record table live (verified).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the transpose with the ragged case handled by a chosen mode; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Ragged columns under all three modes, including the strict throw and longest fill tracking.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 8/8 native pass covers zipKeyed.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Records built from the default columns; filled-gap count reported; console clean.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout, record table in scroller.

accessibility.rationale: Textarea and select labelled, aria-live output, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. Native zipKeyed exercised with honest ragged-column handling.
